name: Consensus Assessment Initiative Questionnaire
description: Vendor self-assessment questionnaire for CCM v4.1: 283 yes/no questions across the 207 CCM v4.1 controls. CSA has issued two workbooks under this one 4.1.0 label, generated 2026-01-13 and 2026-10-02, and 26 question texts differ between them. This directory holds the 2026-10-02 generation, the one CSA serves now; see README.md.
relationToCloudSecurity: Current CSA STAR Registry Level 1 attestation questionnaire.
relationToAISecurity: Covers general cloud security; AI-specific controls in AICM.

known_source_issues.summary: CSA issued two different workbooks labelled CAIQ 4.1.0. Both stamp caiq_version 4.1.0 in cell A1; the first records specification_version 4.1.0 and the second 4.1.1. The second, generated 2026-10-02 (filename token generated_at_2026_10_02), changes the text of 26 of the 283 questions: 19 in punctuation only and 7 in wording (DCS-02.2, DCS-06.2, DCS-11.1, I&S-05.1, IAM-13.1, LOG-07.1, UEM-02.1). The questionnaire's Change Log gains no row: its two rows (CAIQ v4.1 and CAIQ v4.0.3) were only reformatted, from 'CAIQ v4.1 | 2025/11/01 | Question(s)' in January to 'CAIQ v4.1.0 | 2025-11-01 | assessment_questionnaire' in October. Question IDs are unchanged. A bare 'CAIQ 4.1.0' citation therefore identifies two texts. README.md lists every changed question with both texts.

In the 2026-10-02 generation, DCS-11.1 reads 'Are external perimeter datacenter surveillance systems at all ingress and egress points implemented, maintained, and operated?'. The 2026-01-13 text read '…external perimeter datacenter surveillance systems and surveillance systems at all ingress and egress points…'. The control, DCS-11, requires surveillance systems 'at the external perimeter and at all the ingress and egress points'. Read literally, the old question covered both locations and the new one covers one. The extraction keeps CSA's text.
